fijate: Fíjate en la forma, el grosor de la cáscara y si tiene tapones, espina u opérculo.
claves: Redondeado, de cáscara gruesa, con una capa externa mamelonada que la bilis suele teñir de café. Los fértiles miden de 45 a 75 µm.

imagen.descripcionOriginal: ID#: 410 Description: This micrograph reveals a fertilized egg of the round worm Ascaris lumbricoides; Mag. 400X. Fertilized eggs are rounded, have a thick shell. While unfertilized eggs are elongated and larger, thinner shelled, covered by a more visible mammillated layer, which is sometimes covered by protuberances.
